meta.title: B's Cozy Southern Creations
meta.description: Handmade southern cozy knits and custom gifts — blankets, scarves, hats, and resin keepsakes. Perfect for holidays, festivals, teachers, babies, and market-day shopping.

hero.headline: Handmade warmth, southern heart.
hero.lede: Cozy blankets, scarves, hats, and custom knit pieces — stitched one stitch at a time.

custom.title: Tell us the colors. We’ll bring the cozy.
custom.text: Share who it’s for, your favorite colors, and the size you need. We’ll knit something that feels like it was always meant for them — soft pastels, garden greens, or a full southern rainbow.

contact.title: Say hello.
contact.lede: Want a custom blanket, scarf, or hat? Send a note with colors, size, and timeline — we’d love to stitch something for you.
